text:
Priya: @here Customer Acme (tenant: acme-123) opened a support ticket — AWS invoice for Mar shows $4,512 but our Redwood usage dashboard converts to ~$2,200. AWS line items show ~12,000 usageUnits for SKU prod_redwood_infer_1 while our token exports map to ~6,000 units. Can someone help triage?

Alex: Can you paste the AWS line item CSV/JSON and the Redwood daily usage export for that month? Also need the AWS payer account id and invoice id.

Priya: aws_account: 123456789012, invoice_id: INV-6789-2026-03, sku: prod_redwood_infer_1. Partial AWS lineitems below (redacted):
```
invoice_id,aws_account,sku,usageStart,usageEnd,usageUnits,dimension
INV-6789-2026-03,123456789012,prod_redwood_infer_1,2026-03-01T00:00:00Z,2026-03-31T23:59:59Z,6000,Tokens
INV-6789-2026-03,123456789012,prod_redwood_infer_1,2026-03-01T00:00:00Z,2026-03-31T23:59:59Z,6000,Tokens-Partner
```
Our daily_usage_export CSV for tenant acme-123 (aggregated tokens -> units) shows ~6000 units for same month.

Kevin: Huh — two lineitems with identical usageStart/usageEnd and usageUnits. Could be AWS creating separate line items for "partner" vs "marketplace" dimensions. If our marketplace mapping collapses both to the same tenant it will double-count. Also check timezone/rollup differences (we export in America/Los_Angeles, AWS lineitems are UTC).

Sam: I ran a quick join against `aws_account_to_tenant` and `marketplace_lineitems` — looks like this payer account is mapped to two tenant rows because of an old org migration (alias). SQL snippet: 
```sql
SELECT aws_account, tenant_id, count(*) FROM aws_account_to_tenant WHERE aws_account = '123456789012' GROUP BY aws_account, tenant_id;
-- result:
-- 123456789012 | acme-123 | 1
-- 123456789012 | acme-corp-old | 1
```
Both tenant mappings are marked active, so lineitems from AWS are being written twice to billing_export (once per mapping) during the monthly consolidation job.

Priya: That would explain the 2x. Repro steps I think:
1) Have a payer account with a legacy alias mapping to two tenant_ids.
2) AWS exports marketplace lineitems; our billing job expands mappings and emits a row per tenant mapping instead of deduping by invoice+usage window+sku.
3) Dashboard aggregates both rows -> double apparent usage, while invoice shows two line items (AWS billed both because they are partner vs marketplace dimensions) -> customer sees mismatch.

Alex: Action items:
- Priya: attach full invoice PDF + raw AWS lineitems CSV to the ticket. (needed for customer & AWS support). :spiral_calendar:
- Kevin: add a pipeline guard to dedupe lineitems by (invoice_id, sku, usageStart, usageEnd, usageUnits) before expanding tenant mappings. :eyes:
- Sam: run a one-off cleanup to collapse duplicate active mappings for 123456789012, flag any accounts with >1 active tenant mapping.
- Priya: confirm refund/adjustment policy with finance if we need to credit Acme.
- billing-bot: open a vendor support case with AWS Marketplace if we need their confirmation on why partner & marketplace dimensions were emitted separately.

billing-bot: Created ticket AWS-789 for AWS Marketplace support with subject "Duplicate line items for invoice INV-6789-2026-03". Link: https://aws-support.example/ticket/AWS-789

Kevin: Quick suggestion for detection rule: if two lineitems have same invoice_id, sku, usageStart, usageEnd and usageUnits within tolerance, mark as probable-duplicate and don't expand tenant mapping until flagged. We should also surface a metric (duplicate_lineitems_count) in Console.

Sam: I'll run the cleanup now and push a one-off job to recompute the March aggregates for acme-123. I'll post job id when started.

Priya: Thanks team — attaching invoice now and pinging customer with interim note that we're investigating. :thumbsup:

Alex: Keep me posted, we'll coordinate refund if finance approves.

Priya: UPDATE: job started (JOB-8842), initial re-aggregate shows usage aligned with dashboard after dedupe. I'll follow up after JOB-8842 completes.

Sam: JOB-8842 complete — recomputed March aggregates for acme-123, final usage units: 6024 (matches Redwood dashboard). Closing loop with Acme and finance.

Priya: Closing this thread — customer refunded the overcharge and AWS confirmed dimensions are partner vs marketplace duplication. Filing runbook to detect duplicate marketplace lineitems going forward. :white_check_mark:
